notes: Native WebGPU/TSL-only sample; no WebGL fallback.
All visible controls are a second Three.js scene using a JS-generated RGBA DataTexture bitmap font atlas and batched glyph geometry.
The HUD is rendered after the world and never enters the native MRT or planar reflection captures.

OP83 registerStaticScene uploads static world triangles with one linear HDR RGBA terminal hit-radiance value per triangle; animated rain, foliage, vehicle and chrome mobile remain outside that static BLAS.
OP84 evaluateRayReflections consumes same-size FP16 source/normal-roughness/specular-F0 MRT guides plus D32 depth and writes one-bounce native specular to a distinct FP16 HDR output.
Native guide materials for the wet floor, pool and rear glass contain no ReflectorNode or viewport-copy nodes.

If OP83 registration or OP84 evaluation is unavailable, the original materials are restored and three public WebGPU ReflectorNode planar captures provide the fallback; chrome and rough metals retain procedural GGX-prefiltered IBL.
No downloaded models, images, textures, fonts, style sheets or HTML UI are used.
